goal: Generate a coherent horizontal comic spread with 8 panels, ensuring the central binding line does not cut across the main character's face.

story.summary: At the peak of Misty Peak, the boy fights alone against the demon general to protect the mountain gate's seal, turning his sword intent from illusion to reality, ultimately driving back the black mist.
story.main_character: A youth in a blue gown with his hair tied back, cloud patterns on his left shoulder, wielding an ancient sword 'Silent Abyss', with black pupils, slim physique but an extremely steady stance.
story.supporting: The outline of a demon general's upper body with golden pupils floats in the black mist, with no specific human face, identified by claws and a long halberd.

style.art_style: Modern shonen manga + traditional styled armor and detailed fabric folds + speed lines
style.tone: Youthful spirit seen amidst the somberness
style.color: Full-color flat painting, nighttime as the main tone, sword light as cyan-white highlights

page_layout.reading_direction: Japanese style: from right to left, from top to bottom, facing page starts with right page then left page
page_layout.format: Horizontal spread, the image is divided into two pages, with a central gutter as a safe whitespace.

panels.size: Large box on the right page occupying the upper half
panels.scene: The young boy stands on the cliff, with a sea of clouds swirling beneath him, and a blood-red fissure in the far sky
panels.text: Narration: The fog gate that opens every three hundred years, tonight it sounds again.

panels.size: Middle box in the lower right of the right page
panels.scene: Giant claw covered in scales reaching out from black mist, grabbing towards the mark on the boy's chest
panels.text: Demon General: Hand over the mountain gate stamp.

panels.size: Small box in the lower left of the right page
panels.scene: The young boy pushes open the sword hilt half an inch with his thumb, a beam of green light leaks out like a fine line
panels.text: Young boy: If I give, can you catch?

panels.size: Middle upper cell on the left page
panels.scene: The young boy steps on the tiles forward, blue tiles shattering and splashing, in a dive momentum

panels.size: Diagonal cell in the middle right of the left page
panels.scene: The sword light arcs in half a curve, colliding with the long spear of black mist, shockwaves taking on a circular shape

panels.size: Small cell in the middle of the left page
panels.scene: Young boy lands sideways, headband breaks and falls
panels.text: Inner voice: My arm is numb. I can't back out yet.

panels.size: Large cell in the bottom left of the left page
panels.scene: The young boy joins his hands with the sword, a huge pale green sword intent silhouette appears behind him, unfolding like a crane's wings

panels.size: Large cell in the bottom right of the left page connects with the lower edge of the right page
panels.scene: The fog disperses, the demon shadows retreat far away, leaving only moonlight and the scattered stones on the mountains; a boy kneels slightly with his sword planted on the ground
panels.text: Narration: He hears bell sounds from further away. The next calamity is in the city.

dialogue_design.balloon_style: White background + black outline + sharp corners pointing.

must_keep: Framing large, medium, small in rhythm, avoid fully equal-sized grids
The young boy has consistent clothing and facial features across multiple frames
The central axis between pages does not cut the face or the sword's main body.
avoid: Full page with uniform equal-sized grids
Dialogue box obscures the main line of action between frames
